{{Quotation|game|The Shadow Nexus is but a single shard of reality left behind by [[the Five Gods]] when they imprisoned [[Abaddon]]. Once used to control access to his realm, Abaddon has turned their clever scheme upon them and now uses the Nexus to send his foul spawn of Torment to invade other realities.}}

[[The Shadow Nexus (outpost)|The Shadow Nexus]] is the location of the [[Margonite]]s' main attempt to invade [[Tyria (world)|the world]] by creating more [[Chaos Rift]]s. It is from here that all the portals seen previously throughout the game are formed. The [[Order of Whispers]] are present, leading attempts to prevent any further invasion.

==Getting there==
Take the far eastern exit in the [[Gate of Torment]].
